# Chada Digital

> Chada Digital is a small Lagos-based digital studio founded by Okeoma Joseph in 2023. We design websites, set up marketing automation, and create brand identities for Nigerian businesses. Pricing is listed on the site in Naira, timelines are realistic, and we hand over everything when the work is done.

## Founder

Okeoma Joseph — Founder & Lead Engineer. Leads a small team of designers and engineers in Lagos, Nigeria.

## What we do

- **Website Design**: Landing pages, business sites, online shops. Mobile-friendly, findable on Google, built so customers can reach you.
- **Marketing Automation**: Forms that notify you on WhatsApp or email, CRM integration, follow-up sequences that keep working even when you are not at your desk.
- **Brand Identity**: Logo, color palette, typography, social media templates, business stationery.

## Pricing principle

Ten packages, all priced in Naira. You see the price before we start. No hourly retainers — we bill the job, not the clock.

## How we work

1. **Discover** — understand the business, the customers, the budget.
2. **Design** — design and page plan before any code is written.
3. **Build** — site, automation, or brand identity. Progress updates along the way.
4. **Launch** — deploy, test, hand over. Logins, walkthrough, ongoing support if needed.

## Standards

- Deadlines are real. If we name a date, that is the date.
- Questions get an answer within one business day.
- We bill the job, not the clock. You pay for a finished site, a working workflow, or a brand kit.

## Tech stack

Payments: Paystack, Stripe, Flutterwave. Analytics: Google Analytics 4, Plausible, PostHog. CRM & Marketing: HubSpot, Brevo, Mailchimp. Advertising: Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads. Automation: Zapier, Make, n8n. CMS & E-Commerce: Laravel, WordPress, Shopify. SEO: Ahrefs, SEMrush, RankMath. Infrastructure: AWS, Cloudflare, Vercel.

## Live demos

18 clickable live site demos at https://chadadigital.com/demo-lab — grouped by category (shops, clinics, schools, restaurants, agencies, and more). Open any demo and explore the frontend.
